Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITION FOR INVITATION OF BIDS FOR SUPPLY OF I.T EQUIPMENTS INFRASTRUCTURE FOR SCHOOLS 2026-27 Eligibility Online bids are invited for supply of I.T equipments Infrastructure for Schools under different works as per Annexure. · Pre-bid Meeting is Required and shall be held at ACD office on 06-11-2026 at 12.00 Noon. The b idder needs to participate in meeting along with samples and in case of absence, his bid will be re jected on technical evaluation. Bidder shall upload OEM datasheet/brochure along with the bid and shall highlight/mark the exact offered configuration wherever necessary to establish compliance in the Pre-Bid Meeting. · All the formats and certificates enclosed with ATC are required to be submitted after proper seal a nd signature by the bidder. · Bidders participating must have Service Centres in District Budgam or Srinagar. · Complete Delivery Condition: The successful bidder shall deliver all the items in full bef ore generation of the invoice. No payment shall be made against any item(s) until all th e items tendered are not received by the Department in full within the stipulated time. The final invoice shall be processed only after complete delivery and satisfactory receip t/ verification of all items. In no case the payment of any item shall be released separat ely. · Bidders must have to submit Authorization (MAF) from the OEM concerned on the letterhead of OE M which should be duly stamped and signed. · Conditional offer will not be accepted. · The damage during the transportation shall be borne by the bidders. · Delivery location: Delivery of the items shall be as per the location of the work. · OEM Authorization: The bidder shall upload a valid, bid-specific Manufacturer Authorization Form/M anufacturer Authorization Certificate (MAF/MAC) issued on the OEM's official letterhead, specifically mentioning the GeM Bid Number, bid title, quoted product/model and bidder's legal na me. · Bid-Specific OEM Compliance: The bidder shall upload a bid-specific technical compliance certificat e on the OEM's official letterhead, clearly mapping each required specification in the bid to the offe red product/model. Generic brochures, catalogues or undated compliance statements shall not be treated as a substitute for the bid-specific OEM compliance. · OEM Undertaking: The OEM letter shall confirm that the quoted model is genuine, factory-manufact ured, supported by the OEM in India and eligible for warranty/service support.

· Product Model Disclosure: The bidder must clearly mention the exact OEM make, model number/pa rt number and configuration offered. Any deviation from the declared model/configuration shall re quire prior written acceptance by the buyer. · On-site Support: For warranty complaints, OEM/authorized service partner shall provide on-site sup port wherever the OEM's standard warranty terms provide on-site service. Resolution shall be as p er OEM warranty SLA and GeM contract conditions. · Original & New Products: All supplied equipment shall be brand new, unused, genuine, factory-seal ed and current production stock. Refurbished, reconditioned, used, demo or open-box products sha ll not be accepted. · Serial Number Verification: The bidder shall provide complete serial numbers/asset identification d etails at the time of delivery. Buyer shall be entitled to verify the product and warranty status thro ugh the OEM. · Software Authenticity: Windows and Microsoft productivity software, wherever included in the offer ed configuration, shall be genuine and properly licensed. Pre-installed trial-only software shall not be accepted as compliance with a perpetual licence requirement. · Deviation Statement: If any specification is not complied with, the bidder shall explicitly disclose th e deviation. Silence shall not be treated as acceptance of a deviation. · Installation & Commissioning: The bidder shall carry out basic installation/commissioning and dem onstrate successful operation of the supplied AIO at the delivery location, wherever required by the buyer. · Packing & Transit: Equipment shall be supplied in original OEM packaging with appropriate protecti ve packing. Any transit-damaged unit shall be replaced by the bidder/OEM without additional cost to the buyer. · OEM Support Escalation: Bidder shall provide OEM escalation matrix/contact details for warranty a nd technical support, including customer-care/service contact details. · Documentation: User manuals, warranty documentation, licence information and standard OEM do cumentation shall be supplied with each unit. · Quantity Consistency: All units supplied against the order shall be of the same or approved configu ration. Any change in processor, memory, storage, display, webcam, keyboard/mouse or software shall require buyer's prior written approval. · Delivery Compliance: Delivery shall be completed within the delivery period specified in the GeM c ontract. Delay, if any, shall be governed by the applicable GeM contractual provisions. · Inspection & Acceptance: Buyer may inspect the supplied products for make, model, serial number , configuration and physical condition before acceptance. Non-compliant products may be rejected and replaced at the supplier's cost. · Manufacturer Relationship: The bidder shall not quote a model merely based on marketplace availability. The offered configuration must be supported by the OEM and available for institutional /commercial procurement. · Anti-Counterfeit: OEM serial number/warranty verification may be carried out. Any counterfeit, tam pered, duplicate, grey-market or misrepresented product shall be liable for rejection and action as per applicable contract conditions. · Bid-Specific MAF Validity: The MAF/MAC must specifically identify the subject bid and shall not be a generic authorization applicable to all tenders. · OEM Letterhead Requirement: All OEM declarations, MAF/MAC and bid-specific compliance certifica tes must be printed/generated on the OEM's official letterhead and signed by an authorized signat ory, with name, designation, contact details and official email ID. · Bidder Undertaking: The bidder shall certify that the information submitted in the technical bid is tr ue and that the offered product will exactly match the configuration quoted in the bid. · Brand/Model Change: No substitution of OEM, model, part number or configuration shall be permitt ed after award without prior written consent of the buyer and subject to GeM rules.
